adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` attempts to model a catch-all/index signature via computed keys (`[z.string().toString()]`, `[z.string().optional().toString()]`). In Zod, object schemas don’t work this way; those expressions become literal property names (e.g., some stringified representation), not “any string key”, so the schema is not a real catch-all and its validation is incorrect. Additionally, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` explicitly switches to this “minimum” schema when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, which bypasses the provider-specific schema passed in by callers (e.g., Office365/Zoom/Google), meaning provider-specific validation is not applied in that mode and whatever passes the minimal schema can then be used to update persisted credentials.
